Flow thresholds from the record: QMED and flow duration markers

Source: R/flow_markers.R
flow_markers.Rd

Where a catchment has no warning thresholds, the record itself gives flows worth scoring a model against. flow_markers() computes them, in a table that register_data() takes as thresholds; register_data() uses QMED, Q1 and Q5 itself when no thresholds are given.

Usage

flow_markers(
  observed,
  dt,
  time = NULL,
  markers = c("QMED", "Q1", "Q5"),
  complete = 0.9
)

Arguments

observed

Observed flow, m3/s; missing values allowed.

dt

Time step, hours.

time

Optional times of the flows (POSIXct), for water years.

markers

Markers to compute, from QMED, a multiple such as 0.5QMED, or Q<p> with p a percentage between 0 and 100, such as Q1 or Q0.5.

complete

Smallest fraction of a water year's steps that must be observed for its maximum to count towards QMED.

Value

A data frame with name, value (m3/s), unit (flow) and note, and the number of complete years as attribute years.

Details

MarkerFlowCrossed
QMEDMedian annual maximum: the 2-year floodOne year in two
0.5QMED, multiplesFraction of QMED; 0.5 is near a UK POT thresholdA few times a year
Q1, Q5, any Q<p>Exceeded p per cent of the timeAbove Q1 3.6 days a year

QMED follows the Flood Estimation Handbook: the median of the annual maxima of water years, October to September, each year counted only if at least complete of its steps are observed. From 15-minute or hourly data the maxima are near-instantaneous peaks, as the Handbook intends; from daily means QMED is lower. With fewer than 10 years the median is uncertain, and a warning says so; fewer than 2 complete years give no QMED. Without times, years are taken as blocks of 365.25 days from the start of the record.

Exceedance markers count time, not floods: a long wet winter spends many days above Q5 without a notable flood. QMED and its multiples count peaks.

Examples

set.seed(1)
n <- 24 * 365 * 3
q <- exp(stats::filter(rnorm(n, 0, 0.05), 0.995, method = "recursive"))
flow_markers(q, dt = 1)
#> Warning: QMED from 3 complete water years is uncertain; the Flood Estimation Handbook prefers 10 or more.
#>   name   value unit                          note
#> 1 QMED 4.31252 flow Median of 3 water-year maxima
#> 2   Q1 3.44444 flow  Flow exceeded 1% of the time
#> 3   Q5 2.36809 flow  Flow exceeded 5% of the time
flow_markers(q, dt = 1, markers = c("0.5QMED", "Q10"))
#> Warning: QMED from 3 complete water years is uncertain; the Flood Estimation Handbook prefers 10 or more.
#>      name   value unit                                note
#> 1 0.5QMED 2.15626 flow 0.5 x Median of 3 water-year maxima
#> 2     Q10 1.88455 flow       Flow exceeded 10% of the time
